### Local AI is not installed

Local AI answers on this computer. Nothing leaves the machine, and no API key is needed.

Install it from a terminal:

```
sudo pacman -S ollama
```

Then pick **Local AI (Ollama)** here again.
### One download to go\n\nLocal AI is ru:
### One download to go

Local AI is running but has no model to think with yet. **%1** is a good first one at roughly 2 GB. It downloads once, then works offline.

Start by entering:

```
%2
```

Any model from [ollama.com/library](https://ollama.com/library) works too, for example `%2 qwen2.5:0.5b`.
